quest.title: In the Mountains
quest.description: At the adventurer camp, Iris informs you that there seems to be some bizarrely hard ice blocking the paths into the mountain...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, tell me about the ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Perhaps you've already noticed, but that slab of ice is surrounded by a great many blue plants.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I believe that those plants may be related in some way to the shard frozen in the ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If you wish to continue looking for those shards on Dragonspine, I'd say that you might have some luck following the trail of those blue plants.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I believe that the <color=#00E1FFFF>Entombed City Outskirts</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>Starglow Cavern</color> are home to many of those blue plants. You can go and check them out. Perhaps you might discover something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, tell me about the ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Since we've got a way to melt that ice now, that means I can continue organizing expedition parties to explore the mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, tell me about the ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If you'd just like to have a look at the ice, you can just go to the place that I mentioned. For you own safety, don't go any further into the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: This is a sticky situation, indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things here on Dragonspine?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: On this mountain? Well, I can only say that it's more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Apart from the harsh conditions, this mountain is also home to some strange... ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: This ice is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire. It has proved a major obstacle to our exploration as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we have been unable to find a way to deal with that ice, so we've had to go around it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have a look at it.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You're just going to have a look, right? If so, I remember that there was a large slab of ice of that kind on the mountain's outer boundaries. Who knows what's frozen inside it...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You could have a look around there, but remember, it's best not to come this way again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found a shard under the platform.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Hydro Hypostasis fragment introduction...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things here on Dragonspine?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: On this mountain? Well, I can only say that it's more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Apart from the harsh conditions, this mountain is also home to some strange... ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: It is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Worst of all, a few roads have been blocked by this ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Quite a few of our expedition teams have been forced to turn back after being blocked by ice barricades that they could not get around.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder when we're going to find a way to get rid of that ice...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have a look at it.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You're just going to have a look, right? If so, I remember that there was a large slab of ice of that kind on the mountain's outer boundaries. Who knows what's frozen inside it...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You could have a look around there, but remember, it's best not to come this way again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about those blue plants...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If you've a mind to, you can head to the area around the <color=#00E1FFFF>Snow-Covered Path</color>, the <color=#00E1FFFF>Entombed City Outskirts</color> and the <color=#00E1FFFF>Starglow Cavern</color> to have a look. I remember seeing many of those blue plants there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! That thing just flew up into the air... Looked like it was going towards the mountain's summit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shall we go and have a look around? Or should we go back and ask someone about the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—S—So cold... P—Paimon's turning into a Paimon popsicle!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's... going on here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We should go back and ask around at the camp in the foothills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This mountain really is a dangerous place...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Oh? You're back. How did it go? Did you see the ice— Huh. You're in... quite a state, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know anything about the air current in the cavern?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You've already been that high up? That's very impressive. Still... a cavern blocked by a strange air current, you say? Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Ah, that reminds me. We did have an adventure team that also got lucky enough to reach a point very high up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: They couldn't get close enough, but they did report that a cavern near the summit had a strange and powerful air current flowing out from it.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: But logically speaking, no air current in such a place should be that strong. No one knows the reason why, either...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Apart from that strange air current, this mountain is also home to some very strange ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: This ice is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire. It has proved a major obstacle to our exploration as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: We have been unable to find a way to deal with that ice, so we've had to go around it...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: What's more, blue plants are often found growing near this ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I could vaguely see that there was something encased within the ice. But since I was unable to melt it, catching a glimpse of it was as far as I got...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you can follow the trail of blue plants to have a look at that ice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Let me think... I believe that the <color=#00E1FFFF>Entombed City Outskirts</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>Starglow Cavern</color> are home to many of those blue plants. You can go and check them out.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: A strange, powerful air current, bizarre ice, and odd plants...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Hahaha, if this was your standard tale of adventure, there would be some link between these three.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: But in real life, it's best to be practical when adventuring... Make sure you prepare yourself sufficiently before heading up Dragonspine, you hear?

dialogues.text: H—How can this be? How did you do it? Huh... There were strange crystals nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You can use those to melt through the ice? I see, I see... Looks like I'll have to investigate this thoroughly...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Well, let's put that aside first. Looking at you, I suppose you want to continue going deeper into the mountain, yes?

talks.objective: Thaw all the shards out again

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the summit...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: There's a strange, huge pillar floating in mid-air at the summit? To think that there would be such a thing atop Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: And there's a huge space below the ice under the pillar? That's... even weirder.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: This is... inconceivable. Thank you. I will send explorers up there as quickly as we can to see what's happening there.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I should thank you for helping us open the way to the summit. Please take these as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: It seems Dragonspine really does have its secrets after all.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I do hope our next expedition will yield some new discoveries.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The icy surface under the pillar has completely shattered. Looks like there's a huge space underneath it, too. Let's go check it out.
